title: What's new in Expense Agent: Calculate WHT for Expenses (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Setup Configuration: Business and Product Posting Groups
Demo: Employee Card and Expense Category Setup

features.name: Withholding Tax for Employee Expenses
features.description: Extended withholding tax capability from vendors to employees in expense management. Deducts taxes from employee payments based on configured thresholds, posting groups, and calculation methods to ensure tax compliance.
caveats: Calculation complexity varies by jurisdiction - simple or compound methods available
Threshold applicability depends on country-specific rules
Multiple tax posting groups per category supported for multi-tier tax scenarios
Separate session available for broader finance withholding tax features

features.name: Withholding Posting Setup for Employees
features.description: UI setup section for withholding tax configuration including business posting groups, product posting groups, thresholds, calculation base (gross/net/gross up), and threshold type settings.
caveats: Requires both business and product posting group assignment
Configuration must align with local tax authority rules

features.name: Multiple Withholding Tax Groups per Category
features.description: Support for assigning multiple product posting groups to a single expense category to handle multi-tier taxation scenarios (e.g., state, federal, and local taxes simultaneously).
caveats: Complexity increases with multiple tax tiers
Requires careful setup to match local authority requirements

features.name: Gross and Net Withholding Tax Calculation
features.description: Configurable calculation base allowing gross calculation (tax deducted from payment amount), net calculation (tax added on top), or gross-up calculation methods depending on local requirements.
caveats: Selection depends on local tax authority rules
Compound calculation method available for multiple tax scenarios

features.name: Configurable Withholding Tax Thresholds
features.description: Flexible threshold configuration supporting per-record, per-category, per-period, and total-period thresholds. Allows definition of dollar amounts above which withholding taxes apply.
caveats: Threshold type selection depends on employee withholding liability model in each jurisdiction
Period tracking options: month, quarter, year, or fiscal period

features.name: Withholding Tax Entries in Preview Posting
features.description: Withholding tax entries automatically appear in the preview posting view showing GL entries, employee ledger entries, and withholding tax entries with base amount and calculated tax percentage.
caveats: Entries generated based on setup and threshold configuration
Shows both base amount and withholding percentage

features.name: Withholding Tax Calculation Timing (Invoice vs Payment)
features.description: Choice between calculating withholding tax at invoice time (when expense report is posted) or at payment time (when employee is paid), allowing unrealized withholding tax tracking.
caveats: Invoice timing posts at expense report posting
Payment timing leaves withholding unrealized until employee payment

features.name: Employee Card Withholding Tax Fields
features.description: New fields on employee card for withholding tax business posting group assignment and tax exemption flag. Optional fields for certificates and tax-related documentation per jurisdiction.
caveats: Business posting group is required for withholding tax setup
Tax exemption flag available but optional
Certificate fields optional and jurisdiction-dependent

features.name: Expense Category Withholding Tax Configuration
features.description: Expense category setup with withholding tax group assignment. Supports single group or tax group mode for defining multiple product posting groups and component calculation order.
caveats: Single mode for simple one-tier tax scenarios
Tax group mode required for multi-tier taxation
Component order configuration needed for compound calculations
